## AI illustrations
Generated with Google Gemini (`gemini-3-pro-image`) from the prompts in `data/ai_prompts.json`, marked "AI" on the site. Released under CC0 like the rest of our content.

- `ai-p05-quadi-village.jpg` – The Germanic (Quadi) village Pod záhradami at Nebojsa around 300 AD, after the 2011 excavation: pit houses, kiln and well (AI illustration).
- `ai-p01-neanderthals.jpg` – Neanderthals on a gravel bar of the Váh about 90,000 years ago (AI illustration based on the Šaľa 1 and 2 finds).
- `ai-p02-longhouses.jpg` – A first farmers' village on a sand dune above the marshes, around 5300 BC (AI illustration).
- `ai-p04-celtic-village.jpg` – The Celtic village at Veča around 200 BC (AI illustration).
- `ai-p07-ford.jpg` – A Great Moravian settlement by the Váh in the 9th century; a warrior with spear and bearded axe like the one in the Veča grave (AI illustration).
- `ai-p09-ford-castle.jpg` – The ford on the Bohemian Road and the moated castle at Šaľa around 1450 (AI illustration).
- `ai-p10-ottoman-raid.jpg` – An Ottoman raid on Šaľa in 1663 (AI illustration).
- `ai-p12-first-train.jpg` – The first train of the Vienna–Pest line near Galanta, 1850 (AI illustration).
- `ai-p06-avar-slavs.jpg` – Slavs and Avars by the Váh around 700 AD (AI illustration).
- `ai-p14-stefanikov.jpg` – Settlers founding the Štefánikov colony (today Javorinka) near Galanta on land from the land reform, 1921 (AI illustration).
